analysis.title: Analog Devices Inc. (ADI): First Take: Solid quarter and revenue guidance, but Q1 margin light
key_insights: ADI FY4Q26 revenue of $4.37 bn was in line with GS at $4.38 bn and slightly above the Street at $4.33 bn, led by automotive and industrial.
Adjusted gross margin of 74.5% beat GS at 74.0% and the Street at 72.7%. Non-GAAP EPS incl. SBC of $4.06 beat GS $4.00 and Street $3.90.
Communications revenue of $707 mn missed GS at $740 mn and the Street at $726 mn. Industrial at $2.19 bn and automotive at $1.04 bn were at or slightly above expectations.
FY1Q27 guidance: revenue midpoint $4.40 bn is above GS and Street at $4.35 bn, but operating margin of 50.5% is well below GS at 52.4% and Street at 51.2%.
FY1Q27 EPS guidance incl. SBC of $3.82 is below GS at $3.94 and Street at $3.87.
GS expects a modestly lower stock reaction because expectations were elevated after solid analog peer reports.
Call focus: planned R&D and capacity investments and their margin impact, auto and industrial outlook, and datacenter exposure.
Read-across: modestly negative initial reaction for analog group, most direct for NXP (Buy) and ON (Neutral) given auto exposure.
GS maintains Buy with a 12-month PT of $480 (32x P/E on normalized EPS of $15.00), implying 26.7% upside from $378.75.

market_movers.rationale: Solid quarter but light Q1 margin and EPS guide, stock expected modestly lower on a high bar. PT based on 32x normalized EPS of $15.00.
Most direct read-across from ADI given automotive exposure, with a modestly negative initial reaction expected.
Automotive exposure makes it a direct read-across to ADI's margin-light guide.

sector_views.rationale: Modestly negative initial reaction expected for the group after ADI's margin-light guide, though results were solid.

earnings_insights: ADI FY4Q26 reported 11/24: revenue $4.37 bn vs GS est $4.38 bn and Street est $4.33 bn, up 42.2% YoY and 8.7% QoQ.
FY4Q26 reported non-GAAP EPS incl. SBC $4.06 vs GS est $4.00 and Street est $3.90. Adjusted gross margin 74.5% reported vs GS est 74.0% and Street est 72.7%.
FY4Q26 operating margin 52.3% reported vs GS est 52.9% and Street est 52.3%.

FY1Q27 guidance: revenue midpoint $4.40 bn (range $4.25-4.55 bn) vs GS and Street est $4.35 bn. Operating margin midpoint 50.5% vs GS est 52.4% and Street est 51.2%. EPS incl. SBC midpoint $3.82 vs GS est $3.94 and Street est $3.87.
GS EPS forecasts for ADI: FY10/26E $13.00, FY10/27E $17.20, FY10/28E $21.00.
risk_factors: Lack of share gains in auto or industrial end markets.
Increased competition in China could drive price pressure.
Lack of demand reversal in analog.
Planned R&D and capacity investments could pressure margins.
